question: Which of the following statements concerning 압수 and search are 옳지 않은 것들인가? (In cases of dispute, pursuant to 판례)
supporting_precedents:
{"[2020DO10729]": "We 상고이유를 판단한다.

1. a. When 수사기관이 압수ㆍ수색영장을 execute할 때에는 피압수자 또는 defense counsel may participate in 그 집행 (형사소송법 제219조, 제121조). Even where, in the course of 저장매체에 대한 압수ㆍ수색, it is impossible to print and duplicate within the scope fixed, or where exceptional circumstances are recognized in which it is markedly difficult to accomplish the purpose of 압수, and the storage media containing 전자정보, hard copies, or imaging and other forms (hereinafter referred to as the “복제본”) are moved to the 수사기관’s office, etc. for duplication, examination, and printing, the principles of 영장주의 and 적법절차 must still be observed by guaranteeing the opportunity for 피압수자 or defense counsel to participate and by taking appropriate measures to prevent arbitrary duplication, etc. of 전자정보 unrelated to the alleged facts. If such measures were not taken, then, unless there are special circumstances such as where the side of the 피압수자 explicitly indicated an intention not to participate in the above procedures or process, or where it cannot be said that the purpose of guaranteeing participation in the procedure was substantially infringed in light of the nature and content of the process in which the procedural violation occurred, the 압수ㆍ수색 cannot be said to be lawful. The same applies even where the 수사기관 duplicated and printed only the electronic information related to the alleged facts from the storage media or the 복제본 (see 대법원 전원합의체 결정 dated 2015. 7. 16. in 2011MO1839, 대법원 judgment dated 2017. 9. 21. in 2015DO12400, etc.).

Meanwhile, the defense counsel’s 참여권, as provided in 형사소송법 제219조 and 제121조, is an inherent right granted to the defense counsel for the protection of the 피압수자. Therefore, even if the 피압수자 explicitly indicated to the 수사기관 an intention not to participate in the execution of the 압수ㆍ수색영장, the defense counsel must, unless special circumstances exist, be separately guaranteed an opportunity to participate in the execution of the 압수ㆍ수색영장 by being notified in advance of the time and place of execution pursuant to 형사소송법 제219조 and 제122조.

b. 형사소송법 제308조의2 provides that “evidence collected in violation of lawful procedures shall not be admissible as evidence.” This explicitly sets forth the 위법수집증거 배제 원칙 in order to realize the constitutional ideal of guaranteeing the fundamental human rights of the people by suppressing unlawful acts in investigative processes, including unlawful 압수ㆍ수색, and preventing their recurrence (see 대법원 judgment dated 2013. 3. 14. in 2010DO2094, 대법원 judgment dated 2019. 7. 11. in 2018DO20504, etc.). 헌법 제12조 declares the principles of 적법절차 and 영장주의 with respect to 압수ㆍ수색 in order to guarantee fundamental human rights, and 형사소송법 inherits this and establishes specific standards concerning 압수ㆍ수색 procedures so as to harmoniously realize the ideals of discovering substantive truth and protecting individual rights. Since it is necessary to firmly maintain the normative force of the Constitution and 형사소송법 and to suppress unlawful acts in investigative processes, evidence collected not only in violation of lawful procedures but also secondary evidence obtained on the basis thereof should be regarded as having been secured without lawful procedures prepared for the protection of fundamental human rights and, in principle, cannot be used as evidence for conviction.

However, uniformly denying evidentiary admissibility merely because evidence was collected without following the procedures prescribed by law does not accord with the purposes of the Constitution and 형사소송법. This is because the realization of legitimate punitive power through the discovery of substantive truth is also an important goal and ideal that the Constitution and 형사소송법 seek to achieve through criminal procedure. If the 수사기관’s procedural violation does not amount to an infringement of the substantive content of 적법절차, and rather it is an exceptional case in which excluding evidentiary admissibility would be evaluated as producing a result contrary to the intent of the Constitution and 형사소송법 in establishing procedural provisions for criminal procedure so as to seek harmony between the principle of 적법절차 and the discovery of substantive truth and thereby realize criminal justice, the court should find that such evidence may be used as evidence for conviction. Whether this applies must be determined by comprehensively and holistically examining all circumstances relating to the procedural violation committed in the course of the 수사기관’s collection of evidence, namely, the purport of the procedural provision, the content and degree of the violation, the specific circumstances and avoidability of the violation, the nature of the rights or legal interests that the procedural provision seeks to protect and the degree of infringement, the relationship between such rights or legal interests and the defendant, the relationship between the procedural violation and the collection of evidence, and the 수사기관’s awareness and intent. Since this legal principle applies equally to secondary evidence obtained on the basis of evidence collected without lawful procedures, secondary evidence may also be used as evidence for conviction in exceptional cases by comprehensively and holistically considering all circumstances relating to the collection of secondary evidence, focusing on whether the causal relationship between the collection of evidence without procedure and the collection of secondary evidence has been attenuated or severed (see 대법원 전원합의체 결정 dated 2007. 11. 15. in 2007DO3061, 대법원 전원합의체 결정 dated 2015. 1. 22. in 2014DO10978, 대법원 judgment dated 2019. 7. 11. in 2018DO20504, etc.).

2. a. The gist of the charged facts at issue in this case is as follows.

The Defendant, at an unknown time in or before 2019, in the restroom of “○○ Singing Practice Room” located in Uijeongbu-si (address omitted), attached, by using tape, a small camera wrapped in vinyl to the outside of a trash can inside the toilet stall there, attached a portable battery connected to the above camera to the inside of the trash can, and then pressed the record button, thereby filming the buttocks and genitals of an unidentified female who was using the toilet in that restroom; in addition, from around 2013 to around 2019, the Defendant filmed the victims using the toilet in restrooms on a total of 296 occasions as set forth in numbers 1 through 296 of the crime list table cited in the judgment below. In this way, the Defendant, by using a camera or any other mechanical device with a similar function, filmed the body of another person that may arouse sexual desire or cause shame, against that person’s will.

b. The lower court, for the following reasons, found that this portion of the charged facts fell under a case in which the facts constituting the offense were not proven, and thus reversed the first-instance judgment that had found the Defendant guilty and held him not guilty.

1) The investigative agency violated due process by executing the warrant of seizure and search on 2019. 10. 30. in the investigative agency’s office by searching, duplicating, and printing the storage media, without having previously notified the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel of the time and place of execution.

2) Considering that the Defendant was then in custody and the importance of the participation procedure prescribed in 형사소송법 제219조 and 제121조, the above violation of due process was serious in degree.

3) Therefore, video capture printouts, etc. collected through the unlawful 압수ㆍ수색 cannot be used as evidence pursuant to 형사소송법 제308조의2, and the Defendant’s confession is also a product based on those pieces of evidence or the only evidence for this portion of the charged facts, so it cannot be used as evidence of guilt pursuant to 형사소송법 제308조의2 or 제310조.

3. The lower court’s above determination cannot be accepted as is for the following reasons.

a. According to the reasoning of the lower court judgment and the record, the following facts may be found.

1) A judicial police officer affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, Police Lieutenant Nonparty 1, on 2019. 10. 25. at around 09:00, removed from the Defendant’s residence to the police station, by way of taking them out, one computer main unit owned by the Defendant (hereinafter referred to as the “computer at issue”) and one Galaxy Note8 mobile phone (hereinafter referred to as the “mobile phone at issue”), on the basis of the search, seizure, and inspection warrant dated 2019. 10. 24. issued by a judge of the Uijeongbu District Court (hereinafter referred to as the “warrant at issue”).

2) At that time, the Defendant handwrote a “V” mark and signed and affixed his thumbprint on the portions of the confirmation forms for removal of the original for the computer at issue and the mobile phone at issue stating, “I participated in the process of sealing the digital device and storage media and confirmed that there was no problem with the sealing; I was notified that I may participate in the process of unsealing, obtaining the duplicate copy, and searching, duplicating, and printing the digital device, storage media, or duplicate copy; and I will not participate in the above process.”

3) In the first police interrogation of the suspect immediately thereafter, the Defendant stated, “Since 4 to 5 years ago, I installed a hidden camera purchased online in trash cans in restrooms of PC rooms, singing rooms, etc. and filmed women’s genitals, etc., and stored the videos on the hard disk of the computer at issue.”

4) Police Sergeant Nonparty 2, affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, searched the hard disk of the computer at issue on 2019. 10. 25., discovered a number of video files that appeared to have been filmed by the Defendant with a hidden camera, prepared an investigative report to that effect, and attached thereto photographs of the folder screen where the video files were stored.

5) Meanwhile, the Prosecutor filed an application for an arrest warrant against the Defendant on 2019. 10. 25., and a judge of the Uijeongbu District Court, after appointing Attorney Nonparty 3 as the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel on 2019. 10. 26., conducted a pre-arrest suspect interrogation of the Defendant and issued the arrest warrant.

6) In the second police interrogation of the suspect on 2019. 10. 29., the Defendant stated, “From around 2011 to around 2019, I installed hidden cameras in the restrooms of six places in total, including the places of offense stated in the charged facts at issue in this case, such as PC rooms, hospitals, and singing rooms, and filmed other persons’ bodies,” while specifying the places of offense by year.

7) Police Lieutenant Nonparty 1, Police Sergeant Nonparty 4, and Police Corporal Nonparty 2, affiliated with the Gyeonggi Uijeongbu Police Station, each took charge of one of the three hard disks built into the computer at issue and searched them in their office on 2019. 10. 30., then captured the playback scene of the illegal filming video they each found (one scene per video file) and printed it together with the captured image of the corresponding video file information (all such printouts are hereinafter referred to as the “printouts at issue”).

8) However, the investigative agency did not give advance notice to the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel concerning the above search and duplication of the computer at issue and the procedure for creation of the printouts at issue, and neither the Defendant nor the above court-appointed defense counsel participated in those procedures.

b. In light of the foregoing legal principles, when examining the above factual relationship, even if the Defendant indicated to the investigative agency an intention not to participate in the process of searching, duplicating, and printing the computer at issue, the investigative agency should have provided the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel with an opportunity to participate in the above procedure by notifying him in advance of the time and place of execution before searching, duplicating, and printing the storage medium, namely, the computer at issue, in the investigative agency’s office on 2019. 10. 30.; yet it did not do so. Therefore, the lower court’s determination that the investigative agency executing the warrant at issue violated the seizure procedure is proper, and there is no illegality in the lower court’s above determination that violated no rules of logic or experience, did not exceed the limits of free evaluation of evidence, and did not misapprehend the legal principles regarding the nature of the defense counsel’s right to participate.

c. 1) However, when all of the following circumstances ascertainable through the above factual relationship and the record are comprehensively considered, the above procedural violation by the investigative agency does not amount to an infringement of the substantive content of 적법절차, and rather there is ample room to view this as an exceptional case in which excluding the admissibility of evidence collected through the execution of the warrant at issue would produce a result contrary to the intent of the Constitution and 형사소송법 in establishing procedural provisions regarding criminal procedure so as to seek harmony between the principle of 적법절차 and the discovery of substantive truth and thereby realize criminal justice.

a) On 2019. 10. 25., the investigative agency, after confirming from the Defendant, who was then the only person entitled to participate as the person from whom items were seized, that he did not wish to participate in the process of searching, duplicating, and printing the computer at issue, began the search of the computer at issue. At the time of the search, the Defendant had already stated that “illegal filming videos are stored on the hard disk of the computer at issue.”

b) By the time the Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel was appointed, it appears that the investigative agency had already carried out the search of the computer at issue to some extent and had identified at least the location of the folder where the seized electronic information was stored.

c) The Defendant’s court-appointed defense counsel had not inquired of the investigative agency about the status of execution of the warrant at issue, nor had he requested participation in the process.

d) At the time of execution of the warrant at issue, there was no established precedent or internal guideline of the investigative agency that the defense counsel appointed or selected after the commencement of the seizure and search procedure had to be separately notified in advance notwithstanding the person from whom items were seized having waived or refused participation.

e) In the course of executing the warrant at issue, the investigative agency seized videos that the Defendant had recorded, through hidden cameras installed in restrooms of PC rooms, singing rooms, etc. since around 2011, of the bodies of hundreds of victims, and indicted him for 296 of those acts (the charged facts at issue in this case). The Defendant confessed to all of those offenses in the investigative agency and in court.

2) If so, the lower court should have carefully determined, by comprehensively considering the circumstances of the seizure and search pursuant to the warrant at issue, the provisions relating to seizure procedures for electronic information in force at the time of execution of the warrant at issue, the probative purpose of the seized evidence, the circumstances that led to the procedural violation and the investigative agency’s awareness and intent regarding it, and the content and nature of the offense in this case, whether this case falls under an exception to the 위법수집증거 배제 원칙.

Nevertheless, the lower court, based solely on the reasons stated in its opinion, concluded that the evidence collected through the seizure and search pursuant to the warrant at issue could not be used as evidence of guilt and found the charged facts at issue in this case not guilty. In this respect, the lower court erred by misapprehending the legal principles concerning the exception to the 위법수집증거 배제 원칙 and by failing to conduct the necessary examination. The Prosecutor’s ground for appeal pointing out this error is well-founded.

4. Therefore, the portion of the lower court judgment finding not guilty is reversed, and the case is remanded to the lower court for retrial and reconsideration of this portion, and it is so adjudged in accordance with the unanimous opinion of the Justices participating."}

{"[2020DO14654]": "The grounds for final appeal를 판단한다.

1. 쟁점 공소사실의 요지

The Defendant, ① from around 2018. 1. 2. to around 2018. 12. 10., 원심판결 별지 ‘변경된 범죄일람표Ⅰ’ 중 각 아동·청소년 피해자 14명에게 성적 수치심을 주는 성희롱 등 성적 학대행위를 함과 동시에 이들을 이용하여 음란물을 제작하고, ② on 2019. 3. 1., 피해자의 성기 부위 등을 촬영한 사진을 전송하는 방법으로 아동·청소년을 이용한 음란물을 배포하고, and ③ from around 2018. 6. 14. to around 2019. 1. 5., 아동·청소년을 이용한 음란물 총 229건을 소지하였다.

2. Judgment concerning seizure pursuant to the instant warrant

A. The judgment of the court below

The court below는 그 판시 이유를 들어 이 사건 영장에 따라 피고인 주거지에서 피고인 소유의 이 사건 휴대전화 등을 압수한 절차가 영장주의에 위반된다거나 피고인의 압수·수색 절차 참여권을 침해하는 등의 위법이 있다고 볼 수 없다고 판단하였다.

B. The judgment of the Supreme Court

(1) Article 215(1) of the Criminal Procedure Act는 “검사는 범죄수사에 필요한 때에는 피의자가 죄를 범하였다고 의심할 만한 정황이 있고 해당 사건과 관계가 있다고 인정할 수 있는 것에 한정하여 지방법원판사에게 청구하여 발부받은 영장에 의하여 압수·수색 또는 검증을 할 수 있다.”라고 정한다. Accordingly, 영장 발부 사유가 된 범죄 혐의사실과 무관한 별개의 증거를 압수한 경우, 이는 원칙적으로 유죄 증거로 사용할 수 없다. However, 압수·수색의 목적이 된 범죄나 이와 관련된 범죄의 경우에는 그 결과를 유죄의 증거로 사용할 수 있다. A crime related to the criminal suspicion stated in a seizure and search warrant란 압수·수색영장에 기재된 혐의사실과 객관적 관련성이 있고 압수·수색영장 대상자와 피의자 사이에 인적 관련성이 있는 범죄를 말한다. 그중 objective connection with the suspected facts는 영장에 기재된 혐의사실 자체 또는 그와 기본적 사실관계가 동일한 범행과 directly related되어 있는 경우를 의미하나, 범행 동기와 경위, 수단과 방법, 시간과 장소 등을 증명하기 위한 간접증거나 정황증거로 사용될 수 있는 경우에도 인정될 수 있다. 이때 objective connection은 영장에 기재된 혐의사실의 내용과 수사의 대상, 수사 경위 등을 종합하여 구체적·개별적 연관관계가 있는 경우에만 인정되고, 단순히 동종 또는 유사 범행이라는 사유만으로는 인정될 수 없다. And the personal connection with the suspect는 영장에 기재된 대상자의 범죄를 의미하나, 공동정범이나 교사범 등 공범이나 간접정범은 물론 필요적 공범에 대한 피고사건에서도 인정될 수 있다(대법원 2016도13489, 2017. 1. 25.; 대법원 2017도13458, 2017. 12. 5. 등 참조).

(2) 원심판결 이유와 기록에 의하면 다음 사실을 알 수 있다.

(a) 경찰은 피해자가 연락을 주고받은 피고인의 Facebook 계정에 관한 압수·수색 결과를 바탕으로 범인이 피해자와 Facebook Messenger를 통해 대화한 계정의 접속 IP 가입자가 공소외 1(피고인의 모친)임을 확인하였다. 또한 공소외 1의 주민등록표상 공소외 2(피고인의 부친)와 공소외 3(피고인의 남동생)이 함께 거주하고 있음을 확인하였다. 당시 피고인은 위 Facebook 접속지에서 거주하고 있었으나 주민등록상 거주지가 달라 공소외 1의 주민등록표에는 나타나지 않았다. 경찰은 공소외 3을 피의자로 특정한 뒤 압수·수색영장을 신청하였고, 지방법원판사는 경찰 신청대로 이 사건 영장을 발부하였다.

(b) In the instant warrant, 피고인의 동생인 ‘공소외 3’이 범죄혐의 피의자로 특정되어 기재되어 있고, ‘가. 전라북도 전주시 (주소 생략), 나. 피의자 공소외 3의 신체 및 피의자가 소지·소유·보관하는 물건’이 수색·검증할 장소, 신체, 물건으로 기재되어 있으며, ‘피의자 공소외 3이 소유·소지 또는 보관·관리·사용하고 있는 스마트폰 등 디지털기기 및 저장매체’가 압수할 물건으로 기재되어 있다.

(c) When the police arrived at the Defendant’s residence to execute the instant warrant, 피고인은 출근하여 부재중이었고, 경찰은 공소외 1과 공소외 3으로부터 이 사건 피의사실을 저지른 사람은 공소외 3이 아니라 피고인이라는 취지의 말을 들었다.

(d) Accordingly, 경찰은 공소외 1에게 이 사건 영장을 제시하고 위 주거지를 수색하여 피고인 소유의 이 사건 휴대전화 등을 압수하였다. 현장에서 경찰은 각 압수물에 대한 압수조서를 작성하였고, ‘압수경위’란에 “페이스북 접속 IP 설치장소에 거주하는 공소외 3을 피의자로 특정하였으나 현장 방문한바, 형 피고인이 세대 분리된 상태로 같이 거주하고 있었고 모친 및 공소외 3 진술을 청취한바 실제 피의자는 피고인으로 확인됨. 그러나 영장 집행 당시 출근하여 부재중이므로 모친 공소외 1 참여하에 이 사건 영장을 집행함.”이라고 기재하였다.

(3) 위 사실관계를 앞서 본 법리에 비추어 보면, 피고인이 아닌 사람을 피의자로 하여 발부된 이 사건 영장을 집행하면서 피고인 소유의 이 사건 휴대전화 등을 압수한 것은 unlawful하다.

(a) 헌법과 형사소송법이 구현하고자 하는 적법절차와 영장주의의 정신에 비추어 볼 때, 법관이 압수·수색영장을 발부하면서 ‘압수할 물건’을 특정하기 위하여 기재한 문언은 strictly construed되어야 하고, 함부로 피압수자 등에게 불리한 내용으로 확대 또는 유추 해석되어서는 안 된다(대법원 2008도763, 2009. 3. 12. 등 참조).

(b) 경찰은 이 사건 범행의 피의자로 공소외 3을 특정하여 공소외 3이 소유·소지하는 물건을 압수하기 위해 이 사건 영장을 신청하였고, 판사는 그 신청취지에 따라 공소외 3이 소유·소지하는 물건의 압수를 허가하는 취지로 이 사건 영장을 발부하였으므로, 이 사건 영장의 문언상 압수·수색의 상대방은 공소외 3이고, 압수할 물건은 공소외 3이 소유·소지·보관·관리·사용하는 물건에 한정된다.

(c) 비록 경찰이 압수·수색 현장에서 다른 사람으로부터 진범이 피고인이라는 말을 들었다고 하더라도 이 사건 영장에 기재된 문언에 반하여 피고인 소유의 물건을 압수할 수는 없다. 대물적 강제처분은 대인적 강제처분과 비교하여 범죄사실 소명의 정도 등에서 차이가 있을 수 있으나, 일단 피의자와 피압수자를 특정하여 영장이 발부된 이상 다른 사람을 피압수자로 선해하여 집행하는 것이 적법·유효하다고 볼 수는 없다.

(4) Nevertheless, 원심은 그 판시 이유를 들어 이 사건 영장 집행이 적법하다고 판단하였으니, 원심은 피고인 아닌 사람을 피의자로 하여 발부된 영장에 의한 압수절차의 위법성에 관한 법리를 오해하였다.

(5) However, 이 사건 영장을 집행하여 압수한 이 사건 휴대전화 등 중 E310K 휴대전화에서 발견된 파일은 이 사건 영장에 기재된 피의사실과 관계있는 범죄에 관한 것이라고 볼 수 없어 증거능력이 없고, 나머지에서는 범죄에 대한 증거로 사용할 만한 증거가 발견되지 않았으므로, 원심은 위와 같이 위법하게 압수된 이 사건 휴대전화 등에서 취득한 증거를 유죄의 증거로 사용하지 않았다.

Accordingly, 원심의 위와 같은 잘못은 판결 결과에 영향을 미치지 않았으므로, 피고인의 이 부분 상고이유 주장은 받아들일 수 없다.

3. Judgment concerning seizure by voluntary submission

A. 수사기관이 인터넷서비스이용자인 피의자를 상대로 피의자의 컴퓨터 등 정보처리장치 내에 저장되어 있는 이메일 등 전자정보를 압수·수색하는 것은, 전자정보의 소유자 또는 소지자를 상대로 해당 전자정보를 압수·수색하는 대물적 강제처분으로 형사소송법 해석상 허용된다. 압수·수색할 전자정보가 영장에 기재된 수색장소의 컴퓨터 등 정보처리장치 내에 있지 않고 정보통신망으로 연결된 제3자 관리의 원격지 서버 등 저장매체에 저장되어 있는 경우에도, 수사기관이 피의자의 이메일 계정 접근권한에 갈음하여 발부받은 영장에 따라 영장 기재 수색장소의 컴퓨터 등을 이용하여 적법하게 취득한 피의자의 이메일 계정 아이디와 비밀번호를 입력하는 등 피의자가 접근하는 통상적 방법에 따라 그 원격지 저장매체에 접속하여 그곳의 피의자 이메일 관련 전자정보를 내려 받거나 화면에 현출시키는 것은 피의자의 소유에 속하거나 소지하는 전자정보를 대상으로 하는 것이므로, 그 전자정보에 대한 압수·수색을 달리 볼 필요가 없다(대법원 2017도9747, 2017. 11. 29. 참조). If the suspect, when voluntarily submitting a mobile phone, provided the investigative agency with the ID and password for cloud access with the intent to submit electronic information stored not in the phone but in remote places such as cloud managed by a third party, then the electronic information stored in the cloud, etc. may be regarded as voluntarily submitted.

B. Judgment

원심은 그 판시 이유를 들어 피고인이 자발적인 의사에 기하여 소지하고 있던 삼성 휴대전화 갤럭시노트8을 수사기관에 제출하고, 갤럭시노트8에 연결된 SDCard 저장파일, Naver Cloud 파일, Galaxy Note gallery files를 수사기관에 임의로 제출하였다고 판단하였다.

위 법리에 비추어 보면, 원심의 위 판단은 정당하고, 상고이유 주장과 같이 임의제출에 의한 압수절차의 위법성, 임의제출된 증거의 증거능력, 증거 출처 특정 등에 관한 법리를 오해하거나 논리와 경험의 법칙을 위반하여 자유심증주의의 한계를 벗어난 잘못이 없다.

4. Conclusion

Therefore, 상고를 기각하기로 하여, 관여 대법관의 일치된 의견으로 주문과 같이 판결한다."}

{"[2021DO11170]": "The 상고이유 (상고이유서 제출기간이 지난 후에 제출된 상고이유보충서 기재는 적법한 상고이유를 보충하는 범위 내에서) are 판단한다.

1. Regarding the Defendant의 상고이유

A. Regarding the grounds of appeal challenging the 증거능력

1) The 증거능력 of the 전자정보 stored in the two PCs in the OO대 강사휴게실 (hereinafter referred to as “the PCs at issue”)

a) Relevant legal principles

(1) The standards for determining the scope of seizure of 전자정보 and relatedness when an 정보저장매체 containing 전자정보 is 임의제출되는 경우

In light of the importance of 전자정보 stored in an 정보저장매체 from the perspective of, in addition to 적법절차, the 영장주의, and the 비례의 원칙 that the Constitution and the 형사소송법 seek to realize, the protection of 사생활의 비밀과 자유, the right to 정보에 대한 자기결정권, and property rights, a declaration of intent by a person voluntarily 제출하는 an 정보저장매체 to 지정 the 전자정보 contained therein or to 제한 the scope of 제출 must be strictly construed, and it is impermissible for an 수사기관 to carelessly infer the unidentified submitter’s intent. Therefore, where an 수사기관 can readily confirm the submitter’s intent but, without doing so, voluntarily receives an 정보저장매체 containing both 전자정보 related to a specific 범죄혐의사실 and 전자정보 unrelated thereto, it cannot be treated as though all 전자정보 stored in that 정보저장매체 was voluntarily 제출 and seized.

When an 수사기관 seeking to seize 전자정보 seizes an 정보저장매체 and the 전자정보 stored therein by the method of 임의제출, if, due to reasons such as failing to properly confirm the submitter’s intent regarding the specific scope of 제출, the object and scope of the seizure of 전자정보 according to the 임의제출 are unclear or cannot be ascertained, only 전자정보 related to the 범죄혐의사실 that motivated the seizure pursuant to 임의제출 and having at least minimal value capable of proving it shall be subject to seizure. Here, 전자정보 related to the 범죄혐의사실 may include not only the 범죄혐의사실 itself or conduct directly related to an offense based on the same basic factual relationship, but also information that may be used as indirect or circumstantial evidence to prove the motive and background of the offense, the means and method of the offense, the time and place of the offense, and the like. However, such relatedness is recognized only where, taken comprehensively in light of the content of the 범죄혐의사실 that motivated the seizure pursuant to 임의제출, the object of the investigation, the course of the investigation, the process of 임의제출, and the like, there exists a concrete and individual nexus; mere similarity to the 범죄혐의사실 or the fact that the offense is of the same kind is not sufficient to establish relatedness (see, e.g., Supreme Court en banc Decision 2016DO348, decided November 18, 2021).

(2) The guarantee of the right to participate in the search, copying, and printing of 전자정보

Where an 수사기관 that has voluntarily received an 정보저장매체 or a copy thereof containing both 전자정보 subject to seizure and 전자정보 not subject to seizure transfers the 정보저장매체, etc. to the prosecutor’s office or the like and searches, copies, and prints it, in such a series of processes it must, in principle, comply with the 영장 requirement and 적법절차 by guaranteeing the opportunity to participate to the party subject to seizure/search under Articles 219 and 121 of the 형사소송법 (hereinafter referred to as “the person subject to seizure”) or his or her defense counsel, by preparing and delivering a seizure inventory specifying the file details of the seized 전자정보, and by taking appropriate measures to prevent arbitrary copying, etc. of 전자정보 unrelated to the 범죄혐의사실. If such measures were not taken, then, unless there are special circumstances such as where the person subject to seizure expressly indicated an intent not to participate or where, in light of the purpose and course of the 임의제출 or the nature and content of the process in which the act violating the procedure occurred, it cannot be deemed that the purpose of guaranteeing the opportunity to participate in the procedure to the person subject to seizure was substantially infringed, the seizure/search cannot be regarded as lawful, and this is not altered by the fact that the investigative agency copied or printed only 전자정보 related to the 범죄혐의사실 from the 정보저장매체 or its copy.

Furthermore, where a third party such as a victim voluntarily submits, without a warrant, an 정보저장매체 belonging to or under the control of the suspect, it is difficult to deem that the suspect, who is the person substantially subject to seizure, consented to the investigative agency’s unrestricted search of all 전자정보 therein; moreover, even when the suspect himself or herself voluntarily submits the information, in view also of the fact that the suspect’s right to participate, etc. must be guaranteed, unless there are special circumstances, appropriate measures must be taken under Articles 219, 121, and 129 of the 형사소송법 to guarantee the suspect’s procedural rights, such as guaranteeing the suspect the right to participate and delivering a list of the seized 전자정보 (see the above en banc decision in 2016DO348, etc.).

In this way, in addition to the person subject to seizure who voluntarily submitted the 정보저장매체, the “정보저장매체 belonging to or under the control of the suspect” as to which the right to participate must also be guaranteed to a suspect who is not the submitter refers to a case where the suspect, at the time of seizure/search or until a time temporally proximate thereto, actually dominated and managed the 정보저장매체, possessed and exercised exclusive authority to manage and dispose of all 전자정보 stored therein, and did not otherwise transfer or waive it to a third party according to his or her own intent, and thereby may be evaluated as the person substantially subject to seizure with respect to the 전자정보 stored in that 정보저장매체. Whether this applies must be determined not by a legal or ex post facto judgment based on the attribution of rights under civil law, but on the basis of the externally and objectively recognizable factual condition at the time of the seizure/search. Apart from such externally and objectively dominant and managerial conditions concerning the 정보저장매체, persons who merely had prior involvement in the use of the 정보저장매체 or the creation/use of individual 전자정보, or persons identified as the data subject by 전자정보 created in that process, are not to be treated as parties actually subjected to seizure/search.

b) Established facts

The reasons of the lower court judgment and the evidence lawfully admitted show the following facts.

(1) By around 2019. 9. 10., the prosecution had conducted investigative measures, including execution of search-and-seizure warrants for the Defendant’s professor’s research room at OO대 and for ◇◇◇고, with 범죄혐의사실 including 사문서위조 concerning a commendation certificate in the name of the President of OO대 dated 2012. 9. 7. against the Defendant (the facts charged in Seoul Central District Court Case No. 2019GOHAP738), 위조사문서행사 arising from Person 1’s submission of the above commendation certificate in the application process to the Graduate School of Medicine of △△대 and □□대, 위계공무집행방해 concerning the admissions screening work of the Graduate School of Medicine of □□대 arising from the above commendation certificate and other false career entries, and other offenses related to Person 1’s fraudulent application to the medical graduate school.

(2) Person 2 had served as an assistant to the ☆☆ College of OO대 from 2019. 3. 1., and had been responsible for taking over and managing the lecturer break room at OO대 and the items therein from his or her predecessor. The PCs at issue were stored in the lecturer break room without any separate marking as to ownership or legal relations.

(3) The basic purport of Person 2’s statement regarding the ownership and management status of the PCs at issue was that, having been told by his or her predecessor that they were “items left behind by retirees, so return them to the school authorities or handle them as appropriate,” he or she understood them in that way. Furthermore, according to Person 2’s statement, if there were a professor who wished to use the PCs at issue, he or she intended to provide them.

(4) The Defendant’s side also argued, at the first hearing date in the first instance, that the Defendant had never used the PCs at issue and that they had been used only as shared PCs at OO대; although their arguments changed several times up to the lower court, their basic position was that the PCs at issue had been used as shared PCs at OO대, then taken by the Defendant to his or her residence, etc. for use for a certain period, and then returned to OO대 around 2016. 12. so that they could again be used as shared PCs at the OO대 English camp and the like. This is consistent with the state at the time of the search and seizure in this case, in which the objective and actual dominion, custody, and attribution of the authority to manage and dispose of the PCs at issue were with OO대.

(5) While cooperating in the investigation by guiding the prosecutorial investigators through the interior of the ☆☆ College building at OO대 on 2019. 9. 10. based on the cooperation instructions of OO대, Person 2, at the request of the prosecutorial investigator, enabled the prosecutorial investigator to operate one of the PCs at issue and to inspect the 전자정보 stored therein. In the course of the prosecutorial investigator’s search of the 전자정보 stored in that PC in Person 2’s presence, a folder related to Person 3 was discovered, and while the search continued, a situation occurred in which the PC emitted a “pop” sound and powered off. Thereupon, the prosecutorial investigator asked Person 2 and Person 4, the Director of the Administrative Support Office who oversaw the management of OO대’s property, whether they could discontinue the search at the scene and submit the PCs at issue to the prosecution.

(6) In response, Person 2 and Person 4 voluntarily submitted the PCs at issue in response to the prosecutorial investigator’s request, and in that process they entered their personal details, signed, and affixed their seals/thumbprints on the “Consent to Voluntary Submission” form, which stated that they were voluntarily submitting the PCs at issue and listed the PCs at issue in the section for voluntarily submitted items.

(7) At that time, the prosecutorial investigator asked Person 2 and Person 4 whether they wished to attend the imaging and search of the PCs at issue, extraction of electronic information, and the like, but Person 2 and Person 4 replied that they would not attend. Thereafter, Person 2 and Person 4 entered their personal details, signed, and affixed their seals/thumbprints in the section for “the person subject to seizure (voluntary submitter)” of the “Confirmation of Whether to Attend the Submission and Imaging, etc. of an Information Storage Medium” form (hereinafter referred to as the “Confirmation of Whether to Attend”), which stated in substance that they would not attend the hard copy/imaging of the voluntarily submitted information storage medium, search and copying (printing) of electronic information, and the like.

(8) The prosecutorial investigator received the above “Consent to Voluntary Submission” and “Confirmation of Whether to Attend” from Person 2 and Person 4, delivered to them a “Seizure Inventory Receipt” concerning the PCs at issue, and then took the PCs at issue to the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office. In that process, the prosecutorial investigator did not additionally reconfirm with Person 2 and Person 4 their intent regarding the specific scope of submission of the electronic information stored in the PCs at issue.

(9) Thereafter, the prosecution carried out imaging and forensic work on the PCs at issue to extract electronic information, and as a result, evidence was discovered indicating that the 사문서위조 concerning the commendation certificate in the name of the President of OO대 had been carried out around 2013. 6. 16. using one of the PCs at issue.

(10) Accordingly, on 2019. 11. 27., in Seoul Central District Court Case No. 2019GOHAP738, the prosecution filed a motion for amendment of the indictment, changing the existing charged facts that “the Defendant forged a commendation certificate in the name of the President of OO대 by arbitrarily affixing the President’s official seal of OO대 on 2012. 9. 7. at OO대” to the effect that “the Defendant forged a commendation certificate in the name of the President of OO대 in electronic file form using a PC at his or her residence on 2013. 6. 16.” However, upon being denied leave on the ground that the identity of the charged facts was not recognized, the prosecution additionally indicted the Defendant on 2019. 12. 17. in Seoul Central District Court Case No. 2019GOHAP1050 on charged facts identical to those in the motion for amendment of the indictment.

(11) On 2020. 2. 11., the prosecution delivered to Person 2 and Person 4 a list specifying the file details of the electronic information extracted from and seized from the PCs at issue.

(12) The electronic information stored in the PCs at issue was used as evidence of the offenses related to Person 1’s fraudulent application to the medical graduate school among the facts charged in this case, including 사문서위조 dated 2013. 6. 16. (the facts charged in Seoul Central District Court Case No. 2019GOHAP1050).

c) Holding

(1) Voluntary submission of the PCs at issue

In light of the foregoing legal principles, examination of the above facts found shows that, as of 2019. 9. 10., the PCs at issue were not being used exclusively by a specific person for a specific purpose, but were being kept in the lecturer break room for nearly three years on the premise that OO대 personnel would use them as shared PCs at OO대 or otherwise dispose of them at their discretion, and the assistant responsible for the management and custody of the PCs at issue at the ☆☆ College of OO대, Person 2, was carrying out the custody and management duties concerning the PCs at issue. It is therefore recognized that Person 2, the assistant in charge of the custody and management duties at the time, and Person 4, the Director of the Administrative Support Office overseeing the management of OO대’s property, submitted the PCs at issue to the prosecution according to a voluntary intent reflecting OO대’s position.

(2) Necessity and relatedness of the seizure of 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue

(a) In light of the foregoing legal principles, the lower court erred in presuming that, in the case of a voluntary submission of an 정보저장매체 and the 전자정보 stored therein, the object of seizure is not limited to the extent that necessity and relatedness are recognized, and in concluding that, even though the investigative agency did not confirm with Person 2 and Person 4 their intent regarding the specific scope of submission of the 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue, all of the PCs at issue and all 전자정보 stored therein could be regarded as having been voluntarily submitted. The PCs at issue were an 정보저장매체 in which 전자정보 related to the Defendant’s 범죄혐의사실 and 전자정보 unrelated thereto were commingled, and in such a case, it is in principle impermissible to arbitrarily infer the unidentified submitter’s intent and treat all 전자정보 stored in the PCs as having been voluntarily submitted and seized.

(b) Where, as such, the object and scope of seizure of 전자정보 according to the voluntary submitter’s intent cannot be clearly ascertained, only 전자정보 related to the 범죄혐의사실 that motivated the seizure pursuant to the 임의제출 and having at least minimal value capable of proving it should be deemed subject to seizure.

At the time of the voluntary submission of the PCs at issue, the Defendant was already under investigation for the offense of 위조사문서행사 to the effect that a forged commendation certificate in the name of the President of OO대 had been submitted in the application process to the Graduate School of Medicine of △△대 and □□대 by Person 1, as well as for 위계공무집행방해 concerning the admissions screening work of the Graduate School of Medicine of □□대 arising from the above commendation certificate and other false career entries.

Accordingly, 전자정보 created by using the PCs at issue in the process of Person 1’s fraudulent application to the medical graduate school, such as the Defendant’s use of one of the PCs at issue on 2013. 6. 16. to forge the above commendation certificate, can be regarded as evidence having a concrete and individual nexus to proving the motive and background, means and method, and the like, of the offense concerning the above 범죄혐의사실, and even comprehensively considering the object and course of this investigation and the process of voluntary submission, it is sufficient to recognize necessity and relatedness.

(c) Ultimately, among the 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue, the portions used as evidence of the offenses related to Person 1’s fraudulent application to the medical graduate school among the facts charged in this case have both necessity and relatedness for seizure pursuant to voluntary submission; thus, the lower court’s legal error as noted above does not affect the result of the judgment.

(3) Guarantee of the right to participate in the process of search and extraction of the 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue

(a) In light of the foregoing legal principles, the lower court erred in stating, in substance, that when an 정보저장매체 and the 전자정보 stored therein are voluntarily submitted and seized, there is in principle no room to recognize the right to participate on the part of the person subject to seizure or the suspect during the process of searching the electronic information.

The PCs at issue were an 정보저장매체 in which 전자정보 related to the Defendant’s 범죄혐의사실 and 전자정보 unrelated thereto were commingled, and after the prosecution voluntarily received them from Person 2 and Person 4 and seized them, the prosecution moved them to the National Digital Forensics Center of the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office and, in the process of searching and extracting the 전자정보 stored therein, had, in principle, to guarantee the opportunity to participate to OO대, the person subject to seizure.

(b) However, as seen in the facts found above, in light of the course of the search and extraction of the 전자정보 related to the 범죄혐의사실 from the PCs at issue, it is recognized that the prosecution confirmed the intent to participate and afforded an opportunity to Person 2 and Person 4, who were the persons subject to seizure, but that the persons subject to seizure waived that opportunity. Therefore, it cannot be said that there was a defect in the seizure/search procedure for the 전자정보 extracted from the PCs at issue in that the right to participate of the persons subject to seizure was not guaranteed.

Furthermore, in light of the purpose of guaranteeing the opportunity for the persons subject to seizure to participate as one of the 적절한 조치 to prevent distortion of 전자정보 in an information storage medium subject to seizure/search or arbitrary copying of 전자정보 unrelated to the suspected facts (see Supreme Court Order 2009MO1190, dated 2011. 5. 26., Supreme Court en banc Order 2011MO1839, dated 2015. 7. 16., etc.), examining the entire process of the seizure/search in this case, the reasons asserted by the Defendant alone, such as that no additional measure such as detailed notification of the 범죄혐의사실 was taken with respect to Person 2 at the time of seizure pursuant to voluntary submission of the PCs at issue, cannot establish that the purpose of guaranteeing procedural participation to the persons subject to seizure was substantially infringed.

(c) Also, examining the above facts found on the basis of the foregoing legal principles, when viewed according to the objectively and externally recognizable factual condition at the time of the seizure/search pursuant to voluntary submission of the PCs at issue, it cannot be recognized that the PCs at issue or the 전자정보 stored therein belonged to or were under the Defendant’s ownership or control. Rather, in light of objective circumstances such as OO대’s actual domination and management of the PCs at issue by keeping them in the lecturer break room for nearly three years from around 2016. 12. while also seeming to be able to use them as shared PCs or take other measures such as discretionary disposal, it is recognized that OO대 was, at that time, in a state of actually possessing and exercising comprehensive authority to manage and dispose of all 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue.

Even considering all the circumstances asserted by the Defendant, such as that the Defendant had, before around 2016. 12., taken the PCs at issue to the Defendant’s residence, etc. and used them exclusively, or that after around 2016. 12. the lecturer break room where the PCs at issue were stored was near the Defendant’s professor’s research room, it cannot be said that the Defendant’s actual domination and management of the PCs at issue and the authority to manage and dispose of all electronic information stored therein continued until the time of the seizure/search in this case. Accordingly, this case does not fall within a situation in which the Defendant can be evaluated as the person substantially subject to seizure/search in relation to the seizure/search in this case.

Therefore, even under the legal principles set forth in the above Supreme Court en banc Decision 2016DO348, the seizure/search of the 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue does not fall within a case in which the suspect’s right to participate must be guaranteed.

(d) Meanwhile, the Defendant also argues that, during the seizure/search process of the 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue, the Defendant’s side should have been guaranteed the right to participate on the ground that the Defendant’s side was the “data subject” of the 전자정보. As noted above, in order for a suspect to assert a right to participate in the course of searching 전자정보 in an 정보저장매체 voluntarily submitted without the suspect’s involvement, the premise is the suspect’s actual domination and control over the 정보저장매체 and possession of exclusive authority to manage and dispose of all 전자정보 therein. Therefore, this argument cannot be accepted, as it is not intended to recognize the right to participate even to those who merely participated in the creation/use, etc. of individual 전자정보, or to persons who are the data subjects identified by the 전자정보 created in that process, irrespective of such domination and control.

(e) Ultimately, the right to participate was guaranteed to the persons subject to seizure in the course of the search and extraction of the 전자정보 stored in the PCs at issue, and the case does not fall within a situation where the Defendant’s side also had to be guaranteed a right to participate; accordingly, the lower court’s error in this part also does not affect the result of the judgment.

(4) The 증거능력 of the 전자정보 extracted from the PCs at issue

The lower court, for the reasons stated in its judgment, held that the prosecution’s voluntary receipt and seizure of the PCs at issue from OO대, the possessor and custodian of those PCs, did not constitute an unlawful investigation after indictment, that it could not be said that the 증거능력 of the 전자정보 extracted from the PCs at issue was recognized only if the Defendant’s side consented thereto, and that the 전자정보 extracted from the PCs at issue could be used as evidence because the identity and integrity between that 전자정보, the documents printed therefrom, and the originals were proven.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the foregoing legal principles and the facts found above, although there are some inappropriate parts in the lower court’s statement of reasons, the conclusion of the lower court recognizing the 증거능력 of the evidence extracted from the PCs at issue is proper, and there is no error affecting the judgment, such as misapprehension of legal principles concerning compulsory investigation after indictment, the necessity of consent of the data subject in the seizure/search of voluntarily submitted items by a third party’s consent, the status and voluntariness of the custodian in seizure of voluntarily submitted items, the scope of the provisions mutatis mutandis of Article 219 of the 형사소송법 in the seizure of voluntarily submitted items from an information storage medium, identity and integrity with the original, and the 영장 requirement, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

2) The 증거능력 of the results of execution of the search-and-seizure warrants for tracing financial accounts

a) The lower court, for the reasons stated in its judgment, held that, in executing the search-and-seizure warrants for tracing financial accounts, the prosecution’s series of execution methods—sending, through the Criminal Justice Information Network, requests for provision of financial transaction information, copies of the warrants, and copies of the investigators’ identification cards to several financial institutions by electronic fax, receiving financial transaction data by e-mail or fax from the financial institutions, analyzing the received financial transaction data, then finally preparing a list of selected data related to the case, and thereafter directly visiting the financial institutions to present the original warrants, storing the selected data in a storage medium, while also delivering a seizure inventory and preparing a seizure protocol—did not violate the seizure/search procedures prescribed by the Constitution and the 형사소송법, and that the financial transaction data collected and submitted as evidence by such method in this case were admissible.

b) However, as a matter of principle, investigative agencies’ seizure and search must be based on a search-and-seizure warrant issued by a judge, and the original warrant must be presented to the person receiving the disposition (see, e.g., Supreme Court Decision 2015DO10648, decided 2017. 9. 7.; Supreme Court Decision 2018DO2841, decided 2019. 3. 14.). Accordingly, even in executing a search-and-seizure warrant for tracing financial accounts, if the investigative agency did not present the original warrant in advance to the financial institution before receiving financial transaction data from it, such method cannot in principle be regarded as a lawful method of execution.

However, where, as a result of the investigative agency’s request to the financial institution for provision of financial transaction information under Article 4(2) of the Act on Real Name Financial Transactions and Guarantee of Secrecy (hereinafter referred to as the “Financial Real Name Act”), accompanied by a copy of the warrant, the financial transaction data received in reply from the financial institution fall within the objects and scope of execution of the warrant; and where the entire process of requesting provision of financial transaction information and receiving the data by facsimile transmission or electronic transmission is based on the financial institution’s voluntary willingness to cooperate; and where, after going through the procedure of selecting from among the data those financial transactions related to the 범죄혐의사실, the original warrant is finally presented and the seizure procedure is executed for the financial transaction data thus selected; and where the process is carried out in the manner prescribed by the Financial Real Name Act and there are no circumstances suggesting that it was otherwise conducted with the intent to circumvent 적법절차 and the 영장주의 원칙—only in such a case may it exceptionally be regarded as a lawful method of execution of the warrant, on the basis that the entire series of procedures can be evaluated as “presenting the original warrant in a timely manner based on one warrant and seizing/searching on that basis.”

c) In light of such legal principles, examining the process of execution of each of the search-and-seizure warrants for tracing financial accounts in this case, even if the original warrant was not presented in advance to the financial institution before the investigative agency received financial transaction data from it, this case falls within a situation where the subsequent series of procedures—after going through the selection process for data related to the 범죄혐의사실, ultimately presenting the original warrant and directly seizing the selected data—can, viewed as a whole, be evaluated as presenting the original warrant in a timely manner based on one warrant and seizing/searching within the original objects and scope of execution of the warrant on that basis. Nor are there circumstances sufficient to recognize that the investigative agency executed the warrant in the above manner with the intent to circumvent 적법절차 and the 영장주의 requirement.

Accordingly, the lower court’s conclusion that the 증거능력 of the financial transaction data secured in the execution process of the search-and-seizure warrants for tracing financial accounts in this case is recognized is proper, and there is no error affecting the judgment, such as misapprehension of legal principles concerning the method of presenting the warrant and the lawfulness of the seizure/search procedure, the 증거능력 of the seized items and secondary evidence in this part, or insufficient judicial examination, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

3) 120,000 physical shares of [Company Name 1 omitted]

The lower court, for the reasons stated in its judgment, held that the search-and-seizure warrant concerning 120,000 physical shares of [Company Name 1 omitted] was lawfully presented to the person subject to seizure, and that 증거능력 was recognized because the necessity of seizure and relatedness to the 범죄혐의사실 were also recognized.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error, such as misapprehension of legal principles concerning the 증거능력 of this seized item and secondary evidence, or insufficient judicial examination, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

4) The 증거능력 of the audio recording file of a telephone conversation kept by [Company Name 2 omitted]

The lower court, for the reasons stated in its judgment, held that the necessity of seizure and the relatedness to the 범죄혐의사실 were recognized with respect to the audio recording file of the telephone conversation kept by [Company Name 2 omitted], and thus the evidence was admissible.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error, such as misapprehension of legal principles concerning the 증거능력 of this seized item and secondary evidence, or insufficient judicial examination, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

B. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning the offenses related to Person 1’s fraudulent application to the medical graduate school

For the reasons stated in its judgment, the lower court found that the Defendant forged the commendation certificate in the name of the President of OO대 as alleged in the facts charged in this part (업무방해, 위계공무집행방해, the uttering of a forged official document concerning the experiential activity confirmation issued in the name of the head of the ◎◎◎◎ Research Institute of ▽▽대, the uttering of a forged official document as an alternative charge concerning the internship confirmation issued in the name of the head of the ▷▷▷▷▷ Center of ◁ University at △△대, 사문서위조 dated 2013. 6. 16., and 위조사문서행사), and that all other supporting documents were also false; that submitting them in the application process to the Graduate School of Medicine of △△대 and □□대 by Person 1, or entering them in the career history, constituted deception for the offenses of 업무방해 and 위계공무집행방해; that the Defendant’s intent and the conspiracy with Person 1, etc. were recognized in that process; and that this constituted an act obstructing the admissions screening work of each medical graduate school and could not be regarded as merely due to inadequate review by the persons in charge. On that basis, the lower court found this part of the charges guilty.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error affecting the judgment, such as exceeding the limits of the principle of free evaluation of evidence by violating the rules of logic and experience, misapprehension of legal principles concerning the establishment of co-principal liability, the “deception” and “intent” elements of 업무방해 and 위계공무집행방해, or danger of obstruction, or omission of judgment or insufficient judicial examination, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

C. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning fraud and violation of the former Subsidy Act

For the reasons stated in its judgment, the lower court held that the 특별교부금 stated in the facts charged in this part constituted a subsidy under the former Subsidy Act, and that the Defendant fraudulently applied for and received research assistant allowances, thereby finding that this constituted a deceptive act for the offense of fraud. On that basis, the lower court found this part of the charges guilty.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error affecting the judgment, such as exceeding the limits of the principle of free evaluation of evidence by violating the rules of logic and experience, or misapprehension of legal principles concerning the interpretation of Article 2(1) and Article 9 of the former Subsidy Act, Article 4(1) [Appended Table 1] of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, or deception in the offense of fraud, or insufficient judicial examination, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

D. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning the part violating the Capital Markets and Financial Investment Services Act due to the use of undisclosed material information, excluding the part acquitted on grounds

The lower court, for the reasons stated in its judgment, held that, as alleged in the facts charged in this part, the Defendant purchased shares of [Company Name 1 omitted] using undisclosed material information. On that basis, the lower court found this part of the charges guilty.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error affecting the judgment, such as exceeding the limits of the principle of free evaluation of evidence by violating the rules of logic and experience, or misapprehension of legal principles concerning the establishment of the act of using undisclosed material information, the presumption of innocence, insufficient judicial examination, or lack of reasons, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

E. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning the part violating the Financial Real Name Act, excluding the acquitted part

For the reasons stated in its judgment, the lower court held that the Defendant borrowed the accounts stated in the facts charged in this part for the purpose of evading the law and conducted financial transactions for his or her own account, thereby finding that this part of the charges was proven. On that basis, the lower court found this part of the charges guilty.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error affecting the judgment, such as exceeding the limits of the principle of free evaluation of evidence by violating the rules of logic and experience, or misapprehension of legal principles concerning the “purpose of evading the law” in the offense of violating the Financial Real Name Act, or insufficient judicial examination, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

F. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning instigation of destruction of evidence

For the reasons stated in its judgment, the lower court held that the Defendant, as alleged in the facts charged in this part, with the intent to destroy materials related to Person 3 or materials related to Person 5, who were evidence in the Defendant’s criminal case, conspired with Person 6 and Person 7 to cause instigation of destruction of evidence against employees of [Company Name 3 omitted], and that common intent to act jointly and functional control over the act were recognized, and that such conduct by the Defendant constituted an abuse of the right of defense. On that basis, the lower court found this part of the charges guilty.

Examining the reasons of the lower court judgment in light of the relevant legal principles and the evidence lawfully admitted, the lower court’s determination contains no error affecting the judgment, such as exceeding the limits of the principle of free evaluation of evidence by violating the rules of logic and experience, or misapprehension of legal principles concerning the establishment of co-principal liability for instigation of destruction of evidence, the “intent to instigate” and “common intent to act jointly regarding the instigation,” the “evidence relating to a criminal case or disciplinary case” under the offense of destruction of evidence, or abuse of the right of defense, or contradiction in reasons, as argued in the grounds of appeal.

G. Regarding the grounds of appeal concerning instigation of concealment of evidence
